caseName: John Deere Plow Co. v. Franchise Tax Board of California
caseNameFull: John Deere Plow Co. v. Franchise Tax Board of California
attorneys: Arthur H. Kent and Valentine Brookes for appellant. Edmund G. Brown, Attorney General of California, and James E. Sabine, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Butler Bros. v. McColgan, 315 U. S. 501.
